game.title: Cyber Heist

plan.title: Cyber Heist
plan.concept: A top-down stealth infiltration game set inside a high-security data facility. Sneak through neon-lit corridors, steal data cores, and reach the escape portal while avoiding patrol drones and a relentless security chaser.
features: Escape portal unlock after all cores are collected
plan.gameplay_summary: Players move through a compact facility, watching patrol paths and using cover to slip past drones and grab cores. Once every core is stolen, the escape portal activates and the player must navigate back out while the security chaser closes in.
plan.visual_style_summary: Neon-dark corporate sci-fi with glowing terminals, glossy floors, and deep shadowed hallways. The atmosphere should feel tense, high-tech, and clinical with strong blue, purple, and red security accents.
plan.player_appearance: stealth courier in a slim cyber suit
plan.subject: Cybersecurity infiltration and stealth navigation
plan.learning_objective: Players practice planning routes, timing movement, and making safe decisions under pressure.
plan.controls: arrow keys or WASD to move, click/tap for menu actions
plan.replayability: Randomized patrol routes and core placements encourage replaying to improve stealth and escape times.

game.request: Cyber Heist — a top-down stealth infiltration mission. Explore a high-security data facility arena, grab data cores while avoiding patrol drones on routes and a security chaser that hunts you. Timing and evasion over speed, obstacles for cover, neon-dark corporate atmosphere, escape portal opens when all cores are stolen.

spec.title: Cyber Heist
spec.description: Infiltrate a high-security corporate data facility, steal all data cores while evading patrol drones and a relentless security chaser, then escape through the portal before you're caught.
spec.subject: Strategic Thinking & Spatial Reasoning
spec.learning_objective: Players develop spatial awareness, route prediction, risk assessment, and timing strategies by navigating a stealth environment with moving hazards and limited lives — reinforcing systems thinking and adaptive decision-making under pressure.
spec.controls: WASD or Arrow Keys to move | Mobile: Virtual joystick (bottom-left) | Collect all glowing cores to unlock the escape portal | Use obstacles as cover to break line-of-sight from drones | Escape portal opens automatically when all cores are collected

achievements.label: Perfect Ghost: Complete a stage without being spotted
Speed Thief: Escape within 10 seconds of grabbing the last core
Untouchable: Finish 3 consecutive stages without losing a life
Core Rush: Collect all cores in a stage in under 20 seconds
Combo King: Reach a x5 combo multiplier in any single stage
Iron Ghost: Complete the entire game without losing a single life
Cover Artist: Break line-of-sight 5 times in a single stage
Ghost Protocol: Complete stages 7-9 without using a checkpoint

stages.title: Stage 1 — Entry Vestibule
stages.atmosphere: Cold blue-white reception hall. Sparse server racks glow faintly. A lone patrol drone sweeps a slow arc near the entrance. Easy cover, gentle introduction.

stages.title: Stage 2 — Server Corridor Alpha
stages.atmosphere: Glowing data conduits line narrow corridors. Two patrols with offset timing create crossing blind spots. Tight cover placement forces patience.

stages.title: Stage 3 — Surveillance Grid
stages.atmosphere: Red scanline overlays pulse across the floor. Security cameras mounted on obstacles swivel. Two offset patrols with a hungry chaser demand precise corner timing.

stages.title: Stage 4 — Cold Storage Bay
stages.atmosphere: Cryo-blue lighting frosts every surface. Reflective crystal partitions create false sight lines. Three patrols in staggered triangular formation, chaser noticeably faster.

stages.title: Stage 5 — Executive Data Vault
stages.atmosphere: Deep-void aesthetic — black floor with floating holographic asset tags. Elevated security. Patrols move in overlapping figure-eight paths. Chaser has shorter reaction lag.

stages.title: Stage 6 — Neural Network Hub
stages.atmosphere: Deep-orange heat maps pulse through the floor like synaptic fire. Tight corridors between thermal conduits. Patrol patterns shift mid-route — unpredictable reversals keep players off-balance.

stages.title: Stage 7 — Quantum Encryption Wing
stages.atmosphere: Pulsing purple encryption rings phase through the arena. Obstacles flicker on and off in timed cycles. Four patrols with interlocking arcs form near-total coverage — gaps exist but are narrow.

stages.title: Stage 8 — Director's Black Site
stages.atmosphere: Absolute darkness broken only by red motion-sensor strips on the floor. Obstacles are sparse — cover is a privilege. Four aggressive patrols plus a chaser at near-player speed. Precision is survival.

stages.title: Stage 9 — Core Mainframe: FINAL BREACH
stages.atmosphere: The nerve center of the facility blazes in magenta and electric cyan. All systems on maximum alert. Five patrol drones in interlocking diamond formation. The chaser is faster than ever — and the escape portal is far. This is the ultimate run.
